edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. 1) Remove the grey hexagonal metal nut on top of the wooden ladder; the ladder's top step stays plain and empty. 2) The sheet of paper the seated doctor holds out to the patient in the plaid blanket becomes a thick book that he holds out in the same hand, gripped firmly. Its cover has the same brown plaid pattern as the patient's blanket, and a few small blank paper slips stick out between its pages. 3) On the long stone step in front of the hall there is now a small white plate with one spoiled fish on it: greyish-green, with a few wavy stink lines rising above it and one small fly. Keep the doctor's face, hat and robe, the patient, the desk with its gold medal, the folding screen, the ladder, the pillars and the floor exactly as they are. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.
edits.check: 책이 손에 쥐어짐 · 표지가 담요와 같은 체크 · 생선이 「상한」 것으로 보임 · 너트 흔적 없음
edits.fallback: 생선이 싱싱해 보이면 'clearly rotten: grey-green, bones showing at the tail' 한 번. 책이 떠 있으면 2)만 다시
